$comment: QF-MVP-20.4C — immutable historical credit-ledger reconciliation exception register CONTRACT MANIFEST. Freezes the register model, constraints, privileges and immutability contract. This is a SCHEMA CONTRACT ONLY — it contains NO production candidate rows, UUIDs, evidence or PII. The expected post-application state is ZERO rows; any later population is a separate founder-authorized insertion plan.
model: single immutable append-only table with optional self-referencing supersedes_record_id

columns.assignment_id: uuid not null (plain UUID — no FK to operational tables, evidence-preserving)
columns.vendor_id: uuid not null (plain UUID — no FK)
columns.supersedes_record_id: uuid null (self-FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT, append-only supersession)

constraints: clre_supersedes_self_fk FOREIGN KEY (supersedes_record_id) REFERENCES self(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
clre_no_self_supersede CHECK (supersedes_record_id is null or supersedes_record_id <> id)

privileges.owner_postgres: inherent break-glass, documented, not an application path

immutability.update: blocked for every role by trigger trg_clre_immutable (BEFORE UPDATE|DELETE FOR EACH ROW)
immutability.delete: blocked for every role by trigger trg_clre_immutable
immutability.truncate: blocked for every role by trigger trg_clre_no_truncate (BEFORE TRUNCATE FOR EACH STATEMENT)
immutability.future_resolution: append-only via a NEW superseding row (supersedes_record_id); existing decisions are never rewritten

fk_delete_behavior.assignment_id: plain UUID, NO foreign key — an operational delete cannot erase reconciliation history
fk_delete_behavior.supersedes_record_id: self-FK ON DELETE RESTRICT — non-cascading; register rows are never deleted
fk_delete_behavior.rejected: hard FK to lead_assignments/vendors: CASCADE would erase history (forbidden), RESTRICT would couple operational deletes to the immutable register

idempotency.purpose: deterministic duplicate prevention for a later approved insertion plan

financial_effect: NONE — this register records evidence only and carries no credit-mutation semantics; it never alters vendors.total_credits/remaining_credits, vendor_packages.total_leads/remaining_leads, lead_assignments or vendor_credit_logs
